messages.subject: Houlihan Lokey | 2025 Summer Analyst Recruiting Introductory Call
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Hope you are well! We understand that you are interested in our 2025 New York Financial Restructuring Summer Analyst opportunities at Houlihan Lokey and would like to set up a 30-minute introductory call with one of our bankers over the next few weeks. If you are interested, could you please email FRcampusrecruiting@hl.com with your availability for the next two weeks? We will respond back to you as soon as we can with a confirmation of your scheduled date/time.

In the meantime, if you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Best,
Maura Vestal, Senior Campus Recruiter
messages.note: Inbound from a fourth Houlihan party, instructing Jon to write to a fifth (a shared mailbox). Houlihan Lokey is represented in this corpus by SEVEN distinct addresses across both mailboxes.
